reference.code: const f:(total:number,weights:number[])=>number[]|null=(t,w)=>{if(!Number.isSafeInteger(t)||t<0||t>1e7||!w.length||w.some(x=>!Number.isSafeInteger(x)||x<0||x>1e7))return null;const s=w.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);if(!s||s>1e7)return null;const o=w.map(x=>Math.floor(t*x/s));let l=t-o.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);const q:number[][]=w.map((x,i)=>[t*x%s,i]).sort((a,b)=>b[0]-a[0]||a[1]-b[1]);for(let i=0;i<l;i++)o[q[i][1]]++;return o};export{f as allocateFixed};
